notes:
Summary: Velocitree builds real-time decisioning and fraud scoring for payments gateways. Highly latency- and cost-sensitive — primary path is per-transaction fraud score returned inline during auth. Interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private for VPC + KMS. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize to tune batching, caching and quantization.

Workload specifics / customer ask:
- Primary workload: fraud-detection-realtime (single-request classification + short context (<=512 tokens)) used inline in payment auth flow. Also reranking for risk explanations and embeddings for merchant search.
- Perf targets: p95 <= 75ms for 512-token mix; p50 ~ 15ms. Peak throughput target: 500-800 req/s per region. Cost sensitivity: aim to reduce per-inference cost by 30-50% vs current self-hosted cluster.
- Technical preferences: prefer quantized model variants (Q4_0 / int8 where quality ok) but want Redwood Optimize recommendations. Interested in KV/prefix caching for session reuse to cut repeated tokens and continuous batching with tight latency SLOs.
- Benchmarking ask: run Redwood-hosted perf suite using their trace (attached) with two configs: (1) latency-optimized (small batch, aggressive routing, no quant) and (2) cost-optimized (batching, 8-bit quant, prefix cache). Provide token-level cost breakdown and p95/p99 histograms.

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs retained 12 months, and EU data residency for EU merchant traffic. SOC2 + ISO27001 are gating docs for procurement.

Timeline / sales notes:
- Customer wants perf numbers to present to the payments risk committee in early June (2026-06). Procurement has conditional buy once SOC2/DR data residency answered.
- Quoted ARR range requested: mid six-figure to low seven-figure depending on committed capacity and cross-region failover.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We cannot accept intermittent 200ms tails — that kills approvals downstream."
- "If you can show 30-40% unit cost reduction with equal quality we'll push for a 12-month commit."

- Phase 1: Dedicated 3-node reserved pool in NA region for 2-week soak; enable prefix caching and Optimize-suggested batching.
- Phase 2: Private/VPC pilot in customer cloud with KMS and audit hooks.
